class.name: qar_rviz_streaming/QarStreamingPanel
class.description: Qar Streaming control panel. Start/stop the (mock) Qar runtime, add/remove mock peers, start/stop per-peer stereo streams, choose stream resolution and FPS, and view live render diagnostics for the RViz DisplayContext and Ogre scene. There is no peer authorization UI (contractor answer C6); the peer id only identifies/routes a stream.
